not_signoff: Informational geometry estimates only -- NOT foundry sign-off. The pinned curated sky130 deck ships no density and no antenna rules, so no foundry window, threshold, runset or pass/fail stands behind any number here. Simulation- and extraction-derived estimates are provisional until silicon.

controls.intent: overlapping met1 rects union to exactly 6 um2 (no double counting); a child cell placed twice counts both placements (poly 4 um2); absent met5 layer is the empty-layer case (zero density, no error)
one 3x3 window over a 9 um2 denominator: met1 density exactly 6/9; geometry outside the boundary (poly at y=10) never leaks into the windows
a window larger than the boundary clips to the boundary (denominator 2.5 um2, one window, none skipped, met1 fills it completely: density 1.0)
invalid grid (window=0.0, stride=1.0) is refused, not silently tiled
invalid grid (window=1.0, stride=0.0) is refused, not silently tiled
invalid grid (window=1.0, stride=2.0) is refused, not silently tiled

observed.error: stride_um 2.0 must not exceed window_um 1.0 (windows tile the boundary without gaps)

controls.intent: two gates on one net: gate area 0.42*0.15 + 0.84*0.15; cumulative li1 ratio 1/ga, met1 ratio (1+2)/ga; a zero-gate net (n2) is excluded and counted; a gate net with no conductor geometry (n3) is excluded and listed

a component carrying only a label shared by two gate nets (the vddr/vddr3/vddr4 pattern) is ambiguous -- excluded and counted; a component with a unique label still matches; an unlabeled component is counted separately
drift is caught for density, parameter, gate-area and staleness changes; a provenance-only change does not drift; unchanged reproduces
